services.name: Lake Superior Charter Fishing
services.desc: Paulsen's Quickstrike has 30+ years experience targeting anadromous trout and salmon on the world famous Brule River in Wisconsin as well as the turbid rivers of the Minnesota north shore. We can accommodate anglers of any skill level with top of the line spinning, centerpin, and fly rods available to our customers. Credit/Debit card on file required to book. A $200 fee will be charged in the case of cancelation within two weeks of your scheduled trip. No fees will be charged if trip is cancelled by captain due to weather. 3% fee for all credit card transactions. Departure times may slightly vary; your captain will contact you in this

blurb: Paulsen's Quickstrike offers Lake Superior charter fishing trips based out of Superior, WI and Duluth, MN. They provide fully licensed trips in both Wisconsin and Minnesota with experienced captains and guides. Trips are tailored to group goals with a focus on safety, communication, and respect for the fishery.
